resources.string: Choose a file and configure a destination to create a persistent transfer. Copy to app storage or use SMB, HTTPS WebDAV, or SFTP. History is restored automatically; select a task to view progress or control it.

Test remote connections first. Connection settings are persisted, and the transfer library stores passwords encrypted for background execution and recovery. Use trusted servers only. SFTP requires a host fingerprint; WebDAV uses system certificate validation by default.
